lead: A toolbar: a row of buttons, toggles and inputs. Arrow keys move focus between them, so the whole toolbar is a single Tab stop. The buttons reuse Button's look.

api.title: API Reference
api.separator: A vertical line between groups, reusing Separator. It takes no props.

styling.title: Styling Reference
styling.description: Theme styles only handle the frame and spacing in `toolbar.css`; the buttons' look comes from `button.css`.
styling.toolbar: The toolbar itself (background, border, radius) and its groups
styling.reused: The buttons and lines inside, reusing the theme styles of Button and Separator
